qml/components/views/Settings/BarLookSam.reason: draws a bar sample in its bar palette (BarsConfig/BarLook colours: the bar keeps its look, D-24)

qml/components/content/ColorSwatch/Color.reason: shows a colour value; its label reads on it (`Tone.bestOn` once per colour)

qml/components/content/NightLightControl.reason: the night light's colour temperature and the ink that reads on it

qml/components/views/Layouts/CanvasModul.reason: a module tile's fill is the user's colour; its ink is picked once per fill (`Tone.bestOn`)
